subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] Input: add support for Goodix GTX8 Touchscreen ICs
author: Aelin Reidel
status: Submitted community driver; not present in pinned ACK 6.18
local_changes: Explicit required kernel headers and big-endian register addresses
Normandy slot ID masked as in official GT9886 and bounds checked for both families
Rate-limit touch checksum errors and log successful chip identification
Remove archive-obfuscated email from copyright and MODULE_AUTHOR, retain author attribution
RMX2072-only Normandy variant for measured firmware PID 9885; validate the full 72-byte OEM version block checksum and sensor byte before registering input
firmware: Uses pre-flashed touch-controller firmware; no firmware/config flashing or factory Android binary is loaded
device_result: Trial 79 native I2C reads firmware PID 9885; input refused by generic 9886 PID check. Board variant pending build and real touch validation.

official_board_reference.version_read: 72 bytes at 0x452c; u8 checksum zero, PID at offset 9, patch at 17, sensor at 21
official_board_reference.touch_layout: 0x4100, two-byte header, eight bytes per contact, byte-sum checksum

goodix_reference.scope: Normandy family selection and I2C/event layout; not an independent silicon ID proof
